item.title: Smart Suites: Vehicle Sourcing & Import Operations Manager
item.skills: Data Analysis, Communication Skills, and Negotiation
item.description:
Headquarters: National Capital District, Philippines
URL: https://smartsuites.com.au

About the Company

Smart Suites manages a portfolio of over 100 rooms for short-term vacation rentals across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, Carina, and Kuraby in Queensland, Australia. Guided by our core values of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork (COCHET), we are committed to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences to every guest.

Smart Suites is an AI-driven company that continuously adopts and integrates advanced technology, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency, decision-making, and customer satisfaction. We are looking for team members who are equally passionate about using AI tools, data-driven insights, and digital systems to strengthen operations and service delivery.

At Smart Suites, we aim to ensure every guest stay is not only clean and comfortable, but also thoughtfully managed and personalized in a way that leaves a lasting impression.

Know how to spot a good used-car deal?

We are looking for an experienced automotive professional to find vehicles overseas, primarily in Japan, and coordinate their import, preparation and resale in Australia.

You will work remotely from the Philippines, partnering with auction agents, exporters, shipping providers and Australian mechanics and service providers.

What you will do

  • Find vehicles through auctions, dealers and exporter networks.
  • Assess vehicle condition, repair needs and resale potential.
  • Calculate total costs and recommend a maximum buying price.
  • Coordinate imports, repairs, transport and preparation for sale.
  • Manage listings, buyer follow-up and local handover arrangements.
  • Track costs, progress and profit for each vehicle.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in used-car buying, vehicle appraisal, automotive purchasing or vehicle trading.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanical issues, accident damage and repair costs.
  • Ability to interpret auction sheets and recognize risky purchases.
  • Strong commercial judgement, organization and communication skills.
  • Confidence working independently with spreadsheets and online tools.

Japanese auction experience is highly valued. Australian import knowledge is an advantage. Japanese fluency is helpful but not essential if you can reliably interpret and verify vehicle information.

What is on offer

  • Full-time work from home in the Philippines.
  • Fixed monthly pay of 1,300 – 1,500 AUD, depending on experience.
  • Commission equal to 5% of realized net profit per qualifying completed vehicle sale, subject to agreed terms.
  • Opportunity to help build and grow an international vehicle trading operation.

Agreed availability during Australian and Japanese business hours is required.

To apply

Send your CV and a short example of a vehicle you sourced, valued or purchased. Explain how you assessed its condition, buying price, expected costs and resale potential. You may email us at recruitment@smartsuites.com.au﻿

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smart-suites-vehicle-sourcing-import-operations-manager

item.title: Vector Outsourcing Solutions Phils. Inc.: Recruitment Supervisor | Work from Home
item.skills: Team Management, Talent Acquisition, and Negotiation
item.description:
Headquarters: Manila, National Capital District, Philippines
URL: https://www.facebook.com/VectorOutsourcingSolutionsPhil

Salary: 45,000 PHP / monthly

Job Description:

  • Oversee the overall recruitment operations and ensure timely fulfillment of manpower requirements.
  • Coordinate with department heads and hiring managers regarding current and future staffing needs.
  • Establish recruitment priorities and monitor the progress of all open vacancies.
  • Ensure proper delegation of tasks and accountability within the recruitment team.
  • Monitor recruitment performance, productivity, and achievement of hiring targets.
  • Review recruitment reports, hiring metrics, and vacancy updates.
  • Identify recruitment challenges and implement solutions to improve hiring efficiency.
  • Develop and implement effective sourcing and recruitment strategies through partnerships with schools, job fair organizers, PESO offices, and other relevant organizations.
  • Coordinate with management regarding salary recommendations and market benchmarking.
  • Handle escalated recruitment concerns, candidate negotiations, and hiring manager feedback.
  • Ensure proper use and maintenance of recruitment platforms, trackers, and applicant databases.
  • Review and improve recruitment processes, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies and applicable labor regulations.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and performance evaluations to recruitment team members. 
  • Oversee and facilitate weekly HR meetings to discuss recruitment updates, manpower requirements, pending concerns, and department priorities.
  • Report recruitment progress, hiring challenges, team performance, and recommendations to the Chief People Officer/ HR Manager.
  • Ensure that action items and concerns raised during HR meetings are properly monitored and addressed.
  • Follow team and/or client’s proper procedures, policies, and methodologies as instructed.
  • Performs other related duties as necessary or assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BPO Healthcare experience is preferrable but not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least 3–5 years of recruitment experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role and volume hiring experience.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment operations, manpower planning, and hiring targets.
  • Strong knowledge of recruitment strategies, sourcing channels, and talent acquisition best practices.
  • Experience handling recruitment reports, hiring metrics, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
  • Excellent leadership, team management, coaching, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of Philippine labor laws and recruitment compliance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet hiring deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Others:

  • Company Provided equipment / PC set
  • Php 1,000 Rice Allowance
  • Php 1,000 monthly bonus upon regularization
  • HMO upon regularization + 1 Free Dependent
  • Company equipment/ computer is provided
  • Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Vacation Leave
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Government Contribution (SSS, Pag-ibig, Philhealth)
  • Night Shift Differential Pay
  • Bereveament Leave
  • 13th Month Pay

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vector-outsourcing-solutions-phils-inc-recruitment-supervisor-work-from-home
